senses.gloss:
उद्घ उद्-घ, अस्, m. (fr. rt. हन् with उद्),
excellence, happiness; the hollow hand; fire; a model,
a pattern; organic air in the body.

उद्-घन, अस्, m. a carpenter's bench, a plank on
which he works.

उद्-घात, अस्, m. striking, wounding, inflicting a
hurt; a wound, a blow; slipping, tripping; raising,
elevation; a beginning, a thing begun; breathing
through the nostrils as a religious exercise; a club, a
mallet, a weapon; the division of a book, a chapter,
a section.

उद्घातिन्, ई, इनी, इ, uneven, having elevations,
rough.

उद्घट् उद्-घट्, Caus. -घाटयति, -यितुम्, to
open, unlock, unfasten; to peel, shell; to reveal, ex-
pose; to undertake, commence; to rub over, stroke,
tickle.
उद्-घाट, अस्, m. a watch or guard-house.

उद्-घाटक, अस्, m. an opener, the instrument or
implement for opening anything, a key; (अम्), n.
the rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket used
for drawing water.

उद्घट्टक उद्-घट्टक, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घट्ट्
with उद्), a kind of time (in music).

उद्-घाटन, अम्, n. opening, unlocking; an
opener, the instrument or means of opening, a key,
&c.; the rope and bucket of a well, a leather bucket
used for drawing water; hoisting, raising, lifting up.

उद्-घट्टन, अम्, n. kicking of a horse (?);
friction; opening, opening upwards as a lid.
उद्-घाटनीय, अस्, आ, अम्, to be opened.

उद्-घाटित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, manifested; un-
dertaken, commenced; raised, hoisted or lifted up;
done with effort, exerted.
—उद्घाटित-ज्ञ, अस्, आ,
अम्, wise, intelligent.
—उद्घाटिताङ्ग (˚त-अङ्˚),
अस्, आ, अम्, naked; intelligent, wise.
उद्-घट्टित, अस्, आ, अम्, opened, unlocked.
उद्-घाटिन्, ई, इनी, इ, opening, commencing.
उद्घस उद्-घस, अस्, m. (fr. rt. घस्), flesh.

उद्घुष् उद्-घुष्, cl. 1. P. -घोषति, -षितुम्,
to sound, cry out, fill with cries: Caus. -घोषयति,
[]
यितुम्, to cause to sound aloud, to declare aloud;
proclaim, noise abroad.

उद्-घुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, sounded out; proclaimed;
(अम्), n. sound, noise.

उद्-घोष, अस्, m. announcing or proclaiming
aloud; popular talk, general report.

उद्घृष् उद्-घृष्, cl. 1. P. -घर्षति, -षि-
तुम्, to rub, comminute by rubbing; to rub over,
strike against.

उद्-घर्षण, अम्, n. rubbing, rubbing up; rub-
bing the skin with hard substances, as vitrified brick
&c.; a cudgel.

उद्-घृष्ट, अम्, n. a peculiar fault in pronun-
ciation.
